purpose: Provide one provider-neutral readiness gate for HUNT payment routes. It evaluates evidence only and never activates a processor, route, live payment, supplier fulfillment, payout or refund.

payplus.notes: Card/Apple Pay/Google Pay routes stay planned until PayPlus account approval plus staging callback proof.

paypal.notes: PayPal and wallet-via-PayPal routes remain planned until separate official API/account evidence is connected.

dependency_rules: Wallet route cannot be more ready than its processor route.
A route with status=planned and no approval_reference/approved_at is never LIVE_READY_CANDIDATE.
Master hunt_payment_live OFF means no route may become LIVE even if all other evidence passes.
Supplier fulfillment is a separate gate; payment live readiness does not enable hunt_supplier_order_live.
Route readiness never implies legal/tax/settlement readiness unless separately evidenced.
hard_rules: Never activate a payment route from this evaluator.
Never infer commercial approval from configured code or an existing Edge Function.
Never infer live credentials from sandbox credentials.
Never expose processor secrets to the browser.
Never turn on hunt_payment_live or hunt_supplier_order_live.
Never classify a wallet as ready when its underlying processor is not ready.
Material activation always requires explicit Owner Gate outside this evaluator.
